title: Locale chapter file
description: Visible text for one chapter in one language. Segment ids and their order are owned by the matching text/story/chNN.structure.json file.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag, or a tag plus variant such as en-simple. Must be a key of text/locales.json.

scenes.description: Scene id to scene title in this language.

segments.description: Segment id to one short sentence in this language.
